title: K Manga Offers Adachitoka's The Wolf at Memory's End Manga in English
content: K MANGA announced on Saturday that it will release Adachitoka 's The Wolf at Memory's End ( Yadoya no Oinu-sama ) manga in English on October 5. Adachitoka is launching the manga in Kodansha 's Monthly Shonen Magazine on October 6.
author: ANN

title: Chained Soldier Manga Goes on Hiatus Due to Artist Yōhei Takemura's Health
content: Shueisha 's Shonen Jump+ manga website announced on Saturday that writer Takahiro and artist Yōhei Takemura 's Chained Soldier ( Mato Seihei no Slave or literally, Slave of the Magic Capital's Elite Troops) manga will go on hiatus due to artist Takemura's poor health.
author: ANN

content: BookWalker also posted on Linkedin last week that "Premium" and "Early Access" creators on the North American webtoon platform Tapas , particularly those who are impacted by that platform's closure and are "seeking a stable, dedicated storefront to publish and monetize [their] series," can reach out to BookWalker .

title: CloverWorks' Omnibus Anime Film Grotesqqque Streams New English-Subtitled Trailer
content: Aniplex USA streamed a new English-subtitled trailer for Atsushi Nishigori 's original anime film Grotesqqque (previously titled Grotesque) on Sunday. The film is an omnibus film of three stories with different worldviews.
author: ANN

title: Black Clover Season 2’s Premiere Confirms the Disappointing Update Fans Feared
content: After five years of silence, Black Clover has finally returned in all its glory, with improved animation and the adaptation of the important arcs of the series that fans have been waiting for since the anime came to an end.
author: ComicBook

title: 3 Anime to Watch If You Miss Spy x Family
content: WIT Studio and CloverWorks’ Spy x Family anime has emerged as one of the most iconic anime ever, and it is undoubtedly prominent thanks to its main character, Anya. The series blends the charm of family with the found family trope, with every member of the family harboring their own secrets.
author: ComicBook

title: 20 Years Ago Today, Shonen Jump’s Darkest Anime Hero Changed the World Forever
content: There’s no denying that Shueisha’s Weekly Shonen Jump is the biggest manga magazine of all time, known for serializing several classics over the decades. Launched in 1968, the magazine eventually released fan-favorite series such as One Piece, Dragon Ball, Naruto , and many more acclaimed manga.
author: ComicBook

title: 10 Best Anime to Watch on Netflix in October 2026
content: The Fall 2026 anime season is finally here as fans are already set to welcome the new shows. It’s the final quarter of the year, and it’s going to be the biggest one thanks to the return of major shows such as The Apothecary Diaries, Black Clover , and more.
